top_signals.title: Bessent’s political turn in GOP speech tests his bond-market credibility
top_signals.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent's planned Republican convention speech in Dallas is raising questions about how politics could affect market confidence in him.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Porsche Lifts Margin Forecast After €1 Billion Bugatti Sale
top_signals.summary: Porsche AG said it will generate about €1 billion ($1.16 billion) selling its stake in the venture that owns the Bugatti supercar brand as the German manufacturer tries to become leaner.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Met Police investigates Reform UK over potential breach of electoral law
top_signals.summary: The Metropolitan Police has launched a formal criminal investigation into Reform UK over potentially illegal foreign donations after top party officials were filmed facilitating the acceptance of payments via a middle man.  Detectives will look into the party’s funding following the undercover sting operation by Channel 4 News.   The police were called to act by [...]
